INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
(
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    ingest_pipeline_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    exec_group,
    condition_type,
    condition_frequency,
    condition_interval,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_type,
    incr_column_hw_val,
    incr_start_val,
    init_wait_yn,
    extract_query,
    landing_path,
    file_name,
    file_size_mb,
    start_dt,
    end_dt,
    extract_cnt,
    save_cnt,
    attempt_no,
    status,
    error_log,
    created_by,
    created_dt
)
SELECT
    '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
    '-',
    'PL_INGEST_COMMON',
    m.data_class,
    m.ingest_type,
    m.src_type,
    m.target_id,
    m.src_db_nm,
    m.src_schema_nm,
    m.src_table_nm,
    m.cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
    m.exec_group,
    m.condition_type,
    m.condition_frequency,
    m.condition_interval,
    m.incr_column_nm,
    m.incr_column_type,
    m.incr_column_hw_val,
    m.incr_column_hw_val,
    m.init_wait_yn,
    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'DB2' THEN 'SELECT * FROM ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm, ''), m.src_schema_nm) || '.' || m.src_table_nm || ' WITH UR ;'
        WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'MSSQL' THEN 'SELECT * FROM ' || m.src_schema_nm || '.' || m.src_table_nm || ' WITH (NOLOCK) ;'
        ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || m.src_schema_nm || '.' || m.src_table_nm
    END,
    /* landing_path */
    'ingest/'
    || m.data_class
    || '/batch_date=@{substring(variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),1,8)}'
    || '/batch_hour=@{substring(variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),8,2)}'
    || '/pipeline_name=@{pipeline().Pipeline}/',
    /* file_name */
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
            m.cdc_tgt_db_nm
            || '.'
            || m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm
            || '.'
            || m.src_table_nm
        ELSE
            m.src_db_nm
            || '.'
            || m.src_schema_nm
            || '.'
            || m.src_table_nm
    END
    || '.@{variables('v_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'
    || '.parquet',
    0,
    NOW(),
    NULL,
    0,
    0,
    1,
    'PENDING',
    NULL,
    'ADF',
    NOW()
FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m
WHERE m.data_class = 'RAW'
  AND m.ingest_type = 'FULL'
  AND m.init_wait_yn = 'N'
  AND m.delete_yn = 'N';
